IntentErrorNoChapterEnd: There's no chapter end ahead to stop at.
IntentErrorNothingToResume: There's nothing to resume. Play a book or episode in Audiobookshelf first.
IntentErrorPlayerUnavailable: Audiobookshelf can't control playback right now.
IntentErrorSleepTimerUnavailable: Audiobookshelf couldn't set the sleep timer.
IntentJumpDescription: Jumps forward or back in the current book or episode.
IntentResumeListeningDescription: Resumes the current book or episode, or the last one you played.
IntentSetSleepTimerDescription: Pauses playback after some minutes or at the end of the chapter.
IntentTogglePlaybackDescription: Plays or pauses the current book or episode.
